faqIntro.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqIntro.body: Talk with our team about the scope, location, and schedule for your equipment or project.

faq.question: What services does PT SUGEE provide?
faq.answer: We support machinery installation and overhauling, EPOCAST 36 chocking and grouting, laser alignment, in-situ machining, flange management, ship and rig repair, offshore work, fabrication, and related industrial maintenance.

faq.question: Where does PT SUGEE operate?
faq.answer: Our work is coordinated across Indonesia and Singapore for local and overseas projects.

faq.question: What is in-situ machining?
faq.answer: It is precision machining performed at the equipment's location. It can avoid major dismantling and transport while helping reduce downtime.

faq.question: What is EPOCAST 36 used for?
faq.answer: EPOCAST 36 is a resin chocking and grouting product used beneath machinery and equipment to compensate for foundation irregularities, support load transfer, and help manage vibration.

faq.question: How does PT SUGEE manage quality?
faq.answer: We use planned quality checks, inspections, corrective action, and continuous improvement across project and service activities. Certification status can be confirmed directly for projects that require specific documentation.

faq.question: Can I request support for an urgent shutdown or repair?
faq.answer: Yes. Send the equipment details, location, required schedule, and available drawings through the enquiry form or WhatsApp so our team can assess the request.
